title: Cookie Policy

sections.title: 1. What Are Cookies
sections.content: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to the owners of the site. Cookies help us enhance your experience and improve our services.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Cookies
sections.content: We use cookies to understand how you interact with our platform, remember your preferences, and analyze usage patterns. This helps us improve our service and provide you with a personalized experience. We also use cookies for authentication and security purposes.

sections.title: 3. Types of Cookies We Use
sections.content: We use essential cookies that are necessary for the website to function properly. We also use analytics cookies to track usage and performance, and preference cookies to remember your settings. We do not use intrusive or tracking cookies that violate your privacy.

sections.title: 4. Third-Party Cookies
sections.content: We may use third-party services that set cookies on your device. These include analytics providers and payment processors. We ensure that any third-party cookies are used responsibly and in compliance with privacy regulations.

sections.title: 5. Managing Cookie Preferences
sections.content: You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. However, please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our service.

sections.title: 6. Analytics and Performance
sections.content: We use analytics tools to understand how users interact with our platform. This data helps us improve our service and provide better user experiences. All analytics data is anonymized and does not personally identify you.

sections.title: 7. Data Privacy and Cookies
sections.content: Our use of cookies is in accordance with our Privacy Policy. We are committed to protecting your personal data and ensuring transparent data practices. We do not use cookies to collect sensitive personal information without your explicit consent.

sections.title: 8. Consent and Control
sections.content: By continuing to use our platform, you consent to our use of cookies as described in this policy. You have the right to withdraw your consent at any time by adjusting your browser settings or contacting us directly.

sections.title: 9. Updates to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology or regulations. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the updated policy on this page.

sections.title: 10. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions about our Cookie Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at privacy@qorelytics.com. We are committed to addressing any concerns you may have.

footer: By using Qorelytics, you consent to our use of cookies as described in this policy.
